description: One of the Seven Demonlords of Nogreth, and Hilda's younger sister. A free spirit, she does whatever she pleases wherever she pleases, and her partners in crime are ice spirits.After receiving the tragic news of her father's death, she stayed by Hilda's side to support her despite the rage that had overcome her older sister. Upon becoming a member of the Nogreth forces, she is forced to fight against a certain group of knights against her will. However, she values her relationships with others above everything else, and it is this characteristic that eventually helps her win over the heart of the Summoner. Ironically, after losing both her father and her sister, the only friends she has left are her former enemies.
summon:
You wanna be friends? I'm so happy!
And so are my little friends.
Oh, I should introduce you to my big sister!
fusion:
Am I not strong enough yet?
Well, if it's for a friend, I guess I don't mind.
I'll do my best for you!
evolution:
I'll keep going at it,
so I can protect our friends!
Oh, and big sister too!
